sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 5（垫上版）)

purpose.zh: 练肩膀往后打开时还能撑得住，前侧支撑用得上
purpose.en: Trains your shoulders to hold strong when they open up behind you.

text.zh: 手撑在身后，手臂伸直，屁股往前滑
text.en: Hands behind you, arms straight, slide your hips forward

text.zh: 滑到肩前侧拉紧了，用手撑住地，别让肩膀挂着。
text.en: When the front of the shoulders feels stretched, press into the floor, don't hang.

text.zh: 撑住了再用手推着屁股滑回来。
text.en: Once you hold it, push with your hands to slide back.

commonErrors.zh: 肩膀完全放松，挂在那里
commonErrors.en: Letting your shoulders go slack and hang.

commonErrors.zh: 做得太快，一下一下往前冲
commonErrors.en: Going too fast and lunging forward.
Keeping going with a sharp pain at the front of the shoulder.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧刺痛就马上停，滑得短一点
cautions.en: Stop if the front of your shoulder stings, and slide less.

thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
